<thought>To find the Wolff‑Kishner reduction template, I’ll search the template catalog using a simple ketone (acetone) as the reference molecule and specify that a ketone functional group is broken in the forward reaction. This should return templates that perform a ketone → alkane transformation. Then I can pick the first returned template, retrieve its ID and mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
